about_the_game:
Step into the role of a modern-age king, ruling your nation by swiping left or right to make impactful decisions. Every decree shapes your kingdom’s future—balance your economy, military, and popularity while navigating rising conflicts, unexpected events, and growing pressure. As time progresses, new choices unlock, adding complexity and consequence to your reign.

  • War: Even without direct involvement, wars affect your people and neighboring nations. Staying neutral while maintaining safety and diplomacy is a delicate act.

  • Treachery: The murder of a trusted advisor triggers suspicion. Can you lead while doubting everyone around you and uncover the traitor?

  • Spies: Espionage plays a crucial role. Use intelligence to your advantage, but beware—being discovered could worsen international tensions.

Challenge:
Survive the burdens of leadership, outmaneuver betrayal, and maintain peace and power in an ever-changing political landscape. Will you thrive—or fall under the weight of the crown?

short_description: A decision-making card game where you play as a king ruling a nation in the 1940s. As war breaks out in neighboring countries, you must lead wisely; swiping left or right to make choices. Your goal: keep your people safe, maintain stability, and avoid being drawn into the conflict rule for a decade.
